subject: contract-driver-session
text:
- The visual lint — `Session::lint` in process and the `lint` verb, the eighth instance verb, on every carrier (the socket's `call`, the command line, an MCP tool, `help`'s listing) and recorded (§Established Decisions → [Driver session]): `Session::lint(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<Finding>, Refusal>` reads the held instance's current screen and returns one `Finding { id, defect, bounds, reason }` per defect it reads, in document order, then `Defect::ALL` order (packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs:190-230; packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs:176-187). It refuses `fonts-unavailable` before anything is read when `can_paint_text` reads false; it reads `harness.doc.snapshot()`, recording each node's id in the session's record of ids as `snapshot` does, and runs no step, settle, pump or time move, so it changes nothing. `Defect` is closed at six — `Defect::ALL` `Overlap` · `Clipped` · `Truncated` · `OffScreen` · `ZeroSize` · `Contrast`, `name()` `overlap` · `clipped` · `truncated` · `off-screen` · `zero-size` · `contrast` (packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs:95-139) — and `Reason` holds the measured reason: `Overlap { other, area }` · `Clipped { visible }` · `Truncated { text, visible: Option<Bounds> }` · `OffScreen` · `ZeroSize` · `Contrast { ratio, required }` (packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs:141-174). Every rectangle is the lint's own `Bounds { x, y, width, height: f64 }` in the snapshot bounds' space (packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs:16-27), since the crate names neither blitz-dom nor stylo; the four types derive `Debug`, `Clone` and `PartialEq` and hold no `NodeId`, page text, colour or value.
 Each node's clip region is `visible_region` cut by the padding box of every DOM ancestor below the root whose computed `contain` includes `paint` — the lint's own walk, `visible_region` unchanged — with the computed `contain`, `overflow-x` / `overflow-y` and `display` read through `BaseDocument::resolved_style_value` as closed keyword sets. The six readings: `overlap`, two nodes neither an ancestor of the other whose visible parts intersect, reported once at the highest level, on the earlier node — a part scrolled out of view overlaps nothing; `clipped` and `off-screen`, read against that clip region; `truncated`, a node that is no text control whose `text_extent` text box does not lie inside its clip region cut by its own padding box where it clips; `zero-size`, a node with no area that holds a name, a value, an `enabled` reading, focusability or text descendants; `contrast`, a node with direct non-whitespace text or a text control, read through `Harness::text_contrast` and reported below `required_ratio()`, exempt at `enabled == Some(false)`, `None` not measured. The `lint` verb carries it — `Command::Lint`, `Outcome::Linted`, the `{"findings":[…]}` written form, an MCP tool and a recorded step, its answer kept whole — its `command` span recording `verb` and, refused, `cause` alone, no field added, and `VERBS` holds twelve; a node both clipped or off-screen and holding text also reads `truncated`, asserted by no check (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report.md).
